mapper.sql: p.id, p.emp_id, p.work_no, p.hire_date, p.contract_type, p.contract_end_date, p.emergency_contact, p.emergency_phone, p.bank_name, p.bank_account, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, e.real_name AS emp_name, e.username, e.emp_no, d.id AS dept_id, d.dept_name
FROM hr_employee_profile p LEFT JOIN sys_employee e ON p.emp_id = e.id AND e.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE p.del_flag = '0'
